response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/web developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang expertise, but his profile does not align with this role's core requirement of a C++ specialist building high-performance, secure industrial platform solutions. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint and a bachelor thesis project, with no evidence of STL mastery, multi-threaded/networked C++ systems, message brokers, MQTT, IEC 62443 security standards, or industrial automation experience.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience (15+ years)
Strong background in distributed systems, async I/O, and low-latency services (DLang)
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop-leading, and technical communication skills
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last significant use was 2014-2015)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, message brokers, or Azure cloud

key_factors.factor: Strong general distributed-systems and mentoring background
